main_text.head: CAPVT II. Iustificationis doctrina ex scripturis probatur. [illegible, ~6 letters]
main_text.p: DVo iustitiæ genera propo[illegible, ~5 letters] pruris: iustitia Dei, & iu[?] n, non per mo-ide prenfatam, vt Tridentina quæ difpofitio-neritorias con-tatem Dei, fa-obis in scriptu-[?]ac Bellarmino qui cum de for-ret, coneturque em, ira infultat, tamquam in-m scribit : {a}si lib. 2. de iu-stific.cap. 2. si iustificationis ritur imputatio alioquin incho-ac ille. Verisi-inzenus[?] habet, se[?] loqui posse, miramur, si le-regrini[?] de my-nemo enim de icationis recte n illam habeat, tis luce diffipe-putationis, & abimus.
la fide, pro-nuntur in scri-iustitia operum,

page.notes: The left strip of cut-off text belongs to the facing printed page and is not transcribed. The drop-cap paragraph and the italic subtitle under CAPVT II are heavily damaged; several line ends are unreadable. Readings marked [?] are doubtful. Running head fragment at top left is cut and unreadable, so it is left out. The "ac" before Bellarmino and the "se"/"inzenus" readings are doubtful. "regrini" may be the start of a longer word. The "I I" line may be a numeral or a heading. The printed text ends mid-column and the continuation is not visible on this part of the scan.
